title: GTNH NEI LOTR
description: Adds full GTNH NotEnoughItems recipe support for The Lord of the Rings Mod on Minecraft 1.7.10.
body:
GTNH NEI LOTR is a standalone compatibility addon that brings The Lord of the Rings Mod's crafting stations and recipes into the GTNH version of NotEnoughItems.

Browse recipes and usages for Middle-earth crafting tables, Hobbit Ovens, Kebab Stands, Millstones, Ent Jars, Barrel Brewing, and more directly through GTNH's NEI fork.

This rewrite focuses on stability, compatibility, and ease of use. Recipe categories load independently, so a problem with one category won't prevent the others from working. Invalid or malformed recipes are safely skipped instead of crashing the NEI interface.

Features:
• Adds LOTR recipe support to GTNH NotEnoughItems
• Middle-earth faction crafting tables
• Hobbit Oven recipes
• Kebab Stand recipes
• Millstone recipes
• Ent Jar recipes
• Barrel Brewing recipes
• Standard NEI recipe (R) and usage (U) lookups
• Standalone addon with minimal dependencies
• Improved stability and crash handling

Requirements:
• Minecraft Forge 1.7.10
• GTNH NotEnoughItems
• The Lord of the Rings Mod
